failure_reason: Site returns HTTP 403 Forbidden (Varnish cache server, Error 54113) on every request, including the homepage and /robots.txt, blocking access before any content or robots.txt policy can be read. Confirmed via direct HTTP fetch (curl, multiple user agents, IPv4) and via a live Chrome browser through CDP (4 separate fresh-tab attempts on both https://www.leroymerlin.fr/ and https://www.leroymerlin.fr/robots.txt, and https://leroymerlin.fr/), all returning the identical 403/Varnish error page. No Wayback/archive fallback used per hard rule.
notes: All three access tiers exhausted: (1) direct HTTP fetch - 403 on every UA tried; (2) Playwright/CDP - no distinct tool from Claude-in-Chrome in this environment; (3) Claude-in-Chrome (live Chrome via CDP) - 403 on repeated fresh-tab attempts, homepage and robots.txt alike. Because robots.txt itself 403s, no Claude-specific disallow could be read, but this is an infrastructure/WAF-level block (identical Varnish error id across all attempts), not a robots policy opt-out, so status is 'blocked' rather than 'policy_opt_out'. No rows extracted; genuinely could not reach any page to discover seasonal categories. RETRY 2026-09-04: exhausted the alternate-network-path toolkit before re-confirming blocked. (1) curl_cffi TLS-impersonation brute-force across 24 profiles (chrome99-131 incl. Android, edge99/101, safari15_3-safari18_0_ios/safari184_ios, firefox133) against both / and /robots.txt - all 48 requests returned the identical HTTP 403 Varnish 'Error 54113' XHTML error page (byte-identical ~419-420 len), confirming the block is IP/network-reputation-based at the edge, not a TLS-fingerprint check. (2) r.jina.ai reader proxy: succeeded on /robots.txt (got real origin content, see below) and on /sitemap-index.xml (1026 lines, all sitemap-productNNN.xml entries, no category/nav sitemap present) - but every actual category/content page tried (boutique-de-noel hub, decoration-de-noel subpage) returned a CAPTCHA/JS-challenge warning with empty body; forcing X-Engine:direct on the same URL surfaced the real underlying response: HTTP 403 'Please enable JS and disable any ad blocker' - an Akamai-style bot-challenge wall on HTML pages specifically, distinct from the plain edge 403 on other tiers. (3) translate.goog (www-leroymerlin-fr.translate.goog) on the boutique-de-noel URL: 302 redirected into the translate frame but the frame itself resolved to HTTP 403 with only a JS-loader shell, no real content; also tried _x_tr_tl=es, same result. (4) WebFetch tool on homepage: 403. (5) Googlebot UA (direct curl) on / and /robots.txt: 403 both. (6) /sitemap.xml and /sitemap_index.xml via plain curl: 403 both (only reachable through r.jina.ai, and only the product sitemap variant, not a category sitemap). (7) Live Chrome via CDP (Claude-in-Chrome), fresh tab, navigated directly to the boutique-de-noel hub URL: identical 403 Forbidden / Error 54113 / Varnish cache server page as the original attempt - confirms the network-level block still holds even from a genuine full browser on this workstation's egress path. IMPORTANT NEW FINDING: robots.txt content WAS successfully retrieved this time (via r.jina.ai, bypassing the edge block that stops direct/CDP requests) - full text inspected, only 'User-agent: Nutch' (Disallow: /) and 'User-agent: *' (Allow: / with functional-parameter disallows only) sections exist; no Claude-specific (ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai/Claude-Web) disallow entry anywhere in the file. This confirms with actual evidence (not just inference) that this is an infrastructure/WAF block, not a robots policy opt-out - status remains 'blocked', not 'policy_opt_out'.
